definition.prompt: Generate a 5-second animated GIF consisting of 10 evenly spaced animation frames. Make it look like a crude gray Blender viewport animation, not cinematic footage. A single continuous shot inside a rectangular hallway with a tiled floor and simple gray walls. The camera slowly advances toward a doorway. A black humanoid mannequin with unusually long arms emerges from behind the doorway. The camera suddenly whips right, falls onto its side, and stops. The mannequin slowly walks toward and past the fallen camera. Maintain consistent 3D geometry, character proportions, doorway placement, and spatial relationships. No cuts, no teleportation, no scene changes, no added props. Focus on exact camera movement, depth, and timing. The animation should play once as a complete sequence, not return to its starting pose.

review.notes: Returned one PNG containing 10 labeled storyboard panels. No actual 10-frame GIF, playback duration or play-once behavior exists in the file; not accepted as animation.
